evidence.detail: rs/d/b references only R28 SequenceDefinition state and directly indexes the global SequenceDefinition array by the sequence id passed into its two static patch methods.
R28 SequenceDefinition invokes rs/d/b.a(id) and rs/d/b.b(id) for every decoded sequence id immediately after the normal definition decode/customization path.

The first method contains a 106-case sequence-id switch and the second a 73-case sequence-id switch; matching cases replace exact SequenceDefinition frame counts, frame arrays, duration arrays and related playback/control fields.

The class has no independent model, archive or runtime state: its only behavior is deterministic per-id mutation of already-loaded SequenceDefinition records, fixing it as a sequence-definition override table rather than a separate definition type.

proposals.note: SequenceDefinitionOverrides is the conservative semantic name for this exact post-decode sequence-definition patch table; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
